Precisely is an AI-first organization. All employees are expected to demonstrate proficiency in applying AI tools to accelerate their work, improve output quality, and eliminate low-value tasks. Candidates should be comfortable using generative AI tools (e.g., Microsoft Copilot, ChatGPT) in their day-to-day workflows, able to evaluate AI-generated outputs critically, and open to continuously adopting new AI capabilities as they emerge.
Overview:

The AI Program Manager drives delivery and adoption of Precisely’s AI-enabled PMO tool across Professional Services, bridging emerging AI capabilities with the program and project management that runs billable delivery. This is a billable, client-facing role: alongside owning the internal program end to end, the AI Program Manager leads client engagements, carries a target utilization rate, and translates complex AI concepts into decision-ready plans for both internal stakeholders and clients.
What you will do:

Own the AI-enabled PMO program end to end — from use-case intake through rollout and adoption.
Identify high-impact AI use cases across PS workflows and build the ROI case (hours saved, margin).
Deliver billable client engagements, applying AI-enabled PMO capabilities in the field.
Lead AI enablement and training for Professional Services, PMO and OPS.
Govern AI outputs , standards, evaluation, and reconciliation before rollout.
Run program cadence: backlog, stakeholder alignment, status, and reporting.

What we are looking for:

Required:

Bachelor’s degree (business or technical). Equivalent work experience will be accepted in place of the education requirement.
6–8+ years in program/project management (PMP), leading cross-functional programs end to end.
Client-facing delivery in a professional services / consulting environment, comfortable carrying a utilization/billable target.
Stakeholder management across technical and non-technical audiences, up to executive level.
Agile and traditional delivery fluency (Scrum/Kanban, waterfall/hybrid) with PM tooling (MS Project, Wrike, ClickUp, Monday, Smartsheet, or equivalent).
Strong KPI/ROI and metrics discipline — able to define, measure, and report program value.
Working understanding of AI/GenAI, with excellent written, verbal, and executive presentation skills; PMP, PMI-ACP, or CSM certification a plus.
Travel is required: Yes – Approximately 20%

AI Skills/Knowledge:
Precisely is an AI-first organization. All employees apply AI tools daily to accelerate work, improve output quality, and eliminate low-value tasks. Be fluent with generative AI tools (e.g., Microsoft Copilot, ChatGPT, Claude), able to critically evaluate their outputs, and quick to adopt new capabilities as they emerge.
AI/GenAI fluency — practical grasp of LLMs, AI agents, and AI-enabled PMO/automation tools, including where AI fails.
Prompt engineering — structured prompts that generate plans, documentation, analysis, and decision materials.
Data literacy — what data exists, how AI uses it, and the data-quality, privacy, and security implications.
Responsible AI — working knowledge of AI ethics, bias, governance, and emerging regulation.
AI across the delivery lifecycle — planning, risk, status, reporting, and knowledge capture.
Change management & AI adoption — moving teams from pilot to scaled adoption.

Preferred Skills (a plus but not required):

AI/GenAI certification (PMI GenAI for PMs, applied-AI, or responsible-AI credential).
Prior experience standing up an internal AI/automation program or PMO transformation and measuring its ROI.
Background in data management, data integrity, or analytics delivery (aligned with Precisely’s portfolio).
Familiarity with AI agents / agentic workflows and AI governance frameworks (e.g., NIST AI RMF).
Consulting experience translating AI strategy into client-facing roadmaps.

This position is 100% remote anywhere in the US

Bachelor's Degree and 12+ years work experience or equivalent experience

In addition to investigating complex threats, the candidate will have experience advancing investigative methods, and using innovative research approaches to prevent harm to children on our platforms.The candidate will have experience independently identifying and pursuing investigative leads, and delivering measurable outcomes aligned with team goals and will be able to extract, assimilate, and correlate a wide variety of data in order to surface, analyze, and disrupt threat actors across multiple spaces.

Security Analyst Investigator - Youth Safety or Human Exploitation Responsibilities:

Investigate complex child sexual exploitation operations to understand how abuse manifests on Meta’s platforms and the wider information ecosystem
Lead a portfolio of investigative research to include identifying abuse trends, understanding adversarial behavior, and designing forward-looking enforcement strategies to mitigate harm
Proactively hunt for threats and undetected abuse by leveraging internal data sets, open-source intelligence, and third-party private intelligence

jobs.description:
The Technical Programs team in Meta's Security, Integrity, and Investigations organization is looking for an experienced Technical Program Manager who has experience applying technical expertise and organizational skills to drive execution of child safety programs — balancing the needs of multiple stakeholders and the changing regulatory landscape. This position supports scaling infrastructure that enables legal compliance and proactive response across child safety workflows, developing plans with engineering & cross-functional partners, and driving execution through influence or direct intervention.You will be responsible for evaluating, defining, and leading major child safety technology initiatives with cross-functional partners to address high-severity harms involving children and compliance obligations. You will manage and de-conflict executive demands in a fast-paced environment with tight deadlines. This work will be accomplished by working closely with legal SMEs, child safety investigators, policy leads, engineering teams, teammates, and cross-functional internal partners. The candidate should have familiarity with or be willing to work on the intersection of child safety, technology, legal, compliance, and government matters. This is a full-time position.

Scope problems with a cross-organization view and translate complex technical details into simple communications, serving as the connective thread across teams to drive alignment and cohesion within child safety programs
Define technical program strategy, build plans with technical dependencies, and balance trade-offs to deliver desired outcomes in support of the holistic child safety program vision
Drive end-to-end execution and delivery of child safety technical programs from ideation, technical/data analysis, system design, development, testing, implementation, and post-implementation
Drive cross-organization dependencies and alignment, collaborate on success criteria and metrics, and communicate program status with stakeholders across legal, policy, operations, and engineering
Proactively identify risks and issues across child safety systems, work hands-on, and partner across organizations, levels, and skill sets to mitigate and solve those
Drive adoption of technologies across disparate components of the child safety infrastructure stack, thinking through how to advance current technology and scale for emerging obligations
Build consensus around roadmaps and evaluate success by managing execution through tough tactical prioritization decisions while supporting the organization's long-term strategy
Collaborate across teams and peers of all levels — from front-line analysts and investigators to senior executives — in a critical safety environment that deals with high-severity harm involving children

Bachelor's degree in a relevant field (e.g., Computer Science, Engineering, or related discipline)
8+ years of technical program management or product management experience
Experience leading complex cross-functional teams that focus on user safety, child safety, or high-risk harm programs
Experience operating autonomously across a broad problem space, demonstrating critical thinking and thought leadership
Communication experience and experience working with technical management teams to develop systems, solutions, and products
Analytical and problem-solving experience with large-scale systems
Experience establishing work relationships across multi-disciplinary teams and multiple partners in different time zones

Demonstrated ongoing AI skill development (e.g., prompt/context engineering, agent orchestration) and staying current with emerging AI technologies
Knowledge of user needs, gathering requirements, and defining scope in a compliance-driven environment
Experience weighing business requirements and priorities to produce project plans, engineering estimates, and product roadmaps
BS/MS in a technology related area of study

Thales Defense & Security, Inc. (TDSI)
Headquartered in Clarksburg, MD, is a U.S. company that has been serving domestic and international defense Air, Land and Sea domains for 60+ years. With over 1,000 employees, TDSI and its four subsidiaries (Advanced Acoustic Concepts, Digital Receiver Technology, Tampa Microwave, and Trusted Cyber Technologies), supports U.S. Joint Services, special operations forces and multi-national partners with a variety of communication, visualization, signal intelligence/electronic warfare, and sensor/sonar capabilities. TDSI’s key technologies include tactical handheld radios, expeditionary satellite terminals, helmet-mounted displays, optics and target recognition capability, advanced radars, undersea sensing and missile systems. Lives depend on what we do!

(Subject to terms of applicable policies/plans)

Competitive Salary
Yearly Incentive Compensation Plan

Tuition Reimbursement

9/80 Work Schedule (every other Friday off)
Hybrid working environment

We are excited to announce that we have an opening in our Clarksburg, MD
office for an Operations Data Analyst
. The Operations Data Analyst will transform raw operational and business data into actionable insights. The role supports strategic and tactical decision‑making across operations by collecting, cleaning, analyzing, and visualizing data to optimize TDSI processes and performance. This role will work cross-functionally with management, Operations, Engineering, and Finance teams to identify business needs, define KPIs, and support continuous improvement initiatives.

Responsibilities

Data Collection & Management: Acquire and manage TDSI operational, financial, and technical data from internal systems, tools, and stakeholders while maintaining high quality data structures and repositories. Work closely with IT to ensure that SAP, SAP Analytics Cloud (SAC), and other tools (Salesforce, Windchill, etc.) provide the necessary information needed to support data analysis that leads to a common situational understanding.
Data Cleansing: Filter, clean, and troubleshoot all internal TDSI datasets to ensure accuracy, consistency, and readiness for analysis.
Statistical Analysis: Perform statistical and quantitative analysis on TDSI operational metrics to identify performance trends, anomalies, risks, and opportunities for improvement.
Data Visualization & Reporting: Build, maintain, and enhance dashboards, reports, and visual insights using TDSI tools including SAC to support communication with leadership and cross‑functional teams.
Data Monitoring: Monitor key metrics and ensure performance against defined benchmarks and key performance indicators (KPIs). Recommend proactive measures to address issues before they impact performance. Conduct/lead root cause and correct action (RCCA) investigations and recommend strategic solutions.

Qualifications

The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

U.S. Citizenship required. - Applicants selected may be subject to a government security investigation and must meet eligibility requirements for access to classified information.
Bachelor’s degree in a related field such as Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, Economics, or a relevant business discipline. Data Analytics or various sub-disciplines (Data Engineering, Data Science) preferred.
2-4 years+ of relevant experience in Data Analyst role (Operations/ Manufacturing environment highly preferred).
Technical Skills: Proficiency with SQL, Excel, and analytical programming languages (Python/R), with ability to work with TDSI data platforms and operational systems.
Organizational Skills: Excellent communication skills and the ability to present data to a team that enables effective decision making.
Visualization Tools: Experience using BI tools such as SAC, Power BI or Tableau to support reporting within TDSI.
Analytical Mindset: Strong analytical and problem solving skills with the ability to translate technical insights into actionable recommendations for TDSI stakeholders.

The annualized pay range for this role is $83,400- $106,567
USD along with a target incentive compensation plan (ICP) of 5%
. The pay range provided is a good faith estimate representative of the experience level for the role described above. TDSI considers several factors when extending an offer, including but not limited to, the role, function and associated responsibilities, a candidate’s work experience, location, education/training, and key skills.

jobs.title: Senior Project Manager
jobs.description:
What Cognite is: Relentless to achieve

Cognite operates at the forefront of industrial digitalization, building AI
, and data solutions that solve the world’s hardest, highest-impact problems. With unmatched industrial heritage and a comprehensive suite of AI capabilities, including low-code AI agents, Cognite accelerates the digital transformation to drive operational improvements.

We thrive in challenges. We challenge assumptions. We execute with speed and ownership. If you view obstacles as signals to step forward - not backwards - you’ll feel right at home here.

Our Moonshot is bold: Unlock $100B in customer value by 2035, and redefine how global industry works. Join us in this venture where AI and data meet ingenuity, and together, we will forge the path to a smarter, more connected industrial future.

How you’ll demonstrate Ownership

At Cognite, we're transforming the world's most asset-intensive industries through Industrial AI. Our customers rely on us to turn complex industrial data into meaningful business outcomes—and this is where you come in.

We're looking for a Project Manager who enjoys solving complex challenges, takes ownership of outcomes, and is motivated by delivering measurable value. This role goes beyond managing timelines; you'll lead transformational AI implementation projects that help some of the world's largest industrial organisations modernise the way they operate.

From contract signing through deployment and value realisation, you'll partner with customers and cross-functional teams to deliver successful projects that create lasting business impact.

The Impact you bring to Cognite

As the Project Manager, you'll be accountable for the successful delivery of complex Industrial AI implementation projects by:
Leading end-to-end project delivery from kickoff through deployment, adoption, and value realisation.
Owning project scope, schedule, budget, quality, customer outcomes, and commercial performance.
Collaborating with Solution Architects, Software Engineers, Data Scientists, Product teams, and Customer Success to deliver high-quality solutions.
Translating customer objectives into measurable success metrics and facilitating Value Realisation Workshops to demonstrate business impact.
Managing project financials, including forecasting, revenue recognition, profitability, cost management, and reporting.
Building trusted relationships with customer stakeholders, leading steering committees, and providing clear communication throughout the project lifecycle.
Identifying and managing risks, dependencies, and scope changes while ensuring appropriate governance and transparency.
Supporting customer adoption through change management, enablement, and training while recognising opportunities to expand customer value.
Contributing to the continuous improvement of delivery practices by applying Cognite's PMO methodologies, playbooks, and lessons learned.

Required Qualifications

A Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical discipline.
5+ years of experience delivering complex software, SaaS, cloud, or enterprise technology implementation projects.
Experience managing enterprise or industrial digital transformation programmes involving multiple stakeholders and technical workstreams.
Technical fluency with APIs, integrations, cloud platforms, data architecture, and enterprise systems, enabling effective collaboration with technical teams and informed decision-making.
Strong commercial and financial acumen, including forecasting, revenue recognition, margin management, and project profitability.
Experience within one or more industrial sectors, including Energy, Manufacturing, Oil & Gas, Chemicals, Utilities, Power & Renewables, or Life Sciences.
Experience working with Agile delivery methodologies and project governance frameworks such as Scrum, PMP, or PRINCE2.
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to engage confidently across technical teams, customers, and executive stakeholders.
Experience using project management tools such as Jira, Confluence, Microsoft Project, or Smartsheet.
Willingness to travel up to 25% as required.

Preferred Skills

We're particularly interested if you also bring experience in:
PMP, PRINCE2, Agile, or Scrum certification.
Cloud platforms such as Azure or AWS.
Industrial IoT, SCADA, MES, or Operational Technology (OT) environments.
AI, Machine Learning, Data Engineering, or Analytics implementation projects.

Why Cognite?

At Cognite, you'll have the opportunity to work at the forefront of Industrial AI, partnering with some of the world's leading industrial organisations to solve complex, real-world challenges.

You'll join a collaborative, inclusive, and fast-moving environment where innovation, curiosity, and continuous learning are encouraged. We value diverse perspectives and believe great ideas come from people with different experiences and backgrounds.

If you're excited by technology, enjoy working with customers to solve meaningful problems, and want to help shape the future of industry, we'd love to hear from you.

Learn More About Us

Impact 2025
Cognite's Industrial AI: Moonshot
We’re globally recognized domain experts with an international presence that spans Phoenix, Houston, Oslo Tokyo, Bengaluru, and Abu Dhabi.

Equal Opportunity

Cognite is committed to creating a diverse and inclusive environment at work and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive the same level of consideration for employment.

jobs.title: Senior Threat Intelligence Analyst -UK
jobs.description:
Join the mission to make the digital world safer.

About Team Cymru

Team Cymru is the leader in Internet Threat Intelligence. Our unique and global insight empowers an amazing team of analysts to develop industry leading intelligence that is critical to the success of our customer's cyber security efforts.

Team Cymru is an ardent supporter of the Threat Intelligence community. We enable industry collaboration by hosting exclusive conferences each year. Our team members actively participate in working groups, attend industry events, and work directly with fellow community peers.

Job Description

Team Cymru analysts make a difference every day, leading in the battle against those intent on harming others. We are passionate about our mission, and we are looking for an additional teammate who shares in that passion. Do you have a strong background in analytic tradecraft, deductive reasoning, and critical thinking? Would you like to have access to our industry leading threat intelligence data? Are you a proven teammate, mentor, and technical leader? Would you like to join the battle and make a difference in the world? If so, opportunity knocks.

Team Cymru analysts work on research and reporting pertaining to our customers' security and intelligence requirements, empowering them to complete their mission effectively and efficiently. Additionally, our analysts undertake research into other threats and work closely with our engineering teams in the development of our world class analytical tools, data analytics systems, and analysis automation, as well as adding to the body of knowledge of those threats.

As a Senior Threat Intelligence Analyst, you will provide that vital bridge between technical and strategic intelligence research, writing for both practitioner and senior leadership audiences to understand the impact of the threat, while explaining the technical details and rationale behind those assessments, the best of both worlds!

Responsibilities:

Threat Research

Conduct extensive, proactive research into threat actors, malware families, campaigns, and evolving TTPs to maintain relevance and deepen Team Cymru's body of knowledge
Investigate and present operational and strategic intelligence on threat actors, including attribution, motivation, capability assessment, and geopolitical context
Lead short- and long-term threat tracking projects, identifying intelligence gaps and proposing targeted research to address collection shortfalls
Evaluate tools, methodologies, and best practices for understanding adversary TTPs, and proactively share knowledge and techniques with peers

Network and Infrastructure Analysis

Perform deep network traffic and infrastructure analysis to support both customer requests and independent research, using Team Cymru's unique global dataset
Analyze PCAP, NetFlow, passive DNS (PDNS), open ports, certificates, and other datasets to map malicious infrastructure and identify related threat actor assets
Identify and refine indicators of compromise (IOCs) and threat actor TTPs, translating these into automated tracking mechanisms where possible to enable ongoing monitoring of threats and adversary groups

Reporting

Receive, triage, and respond to customer requests with timely, written technical threat intelligence reports tailored to the customer's specific threat landscape and intelligence requirements
Ensure all finished intelligence products meet Team Cymru's analytic standards: clear structure, appropriate use of estimative language and confidence levels, and actionable conclusions
Conduct peer review of colleagues' reporting to maintain consistency, accuracy, objectivity, and analytic rigor across all published products

Collaboration

Work closely with colleagues in the development of analytical tools, data analytics systems, research methodologies, and analysis automation capabilities
Support our threat detection and data acquisition teams to align signature development and telemetry collection with overarching threat intelligence priorities
Participate in working groups, industry events, and community collaboration as a representative of Team Cymru's intelligence capability

Qualifications & Experience

5+ years of experience as a threat intelligence analyst, network forensics analyst, or IT security analyst
Preferably, a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Cybersecurity, or equivalent
Exceptional oral and written communication skills, with the ability to produce customer-facing intelligence reports under time pressure. Experience using structured analysis techniques, estimative language, and confidence levels is preferred
Proven track record of leading complex analytical projects or investigations, including the ability to manage multiple concurrent work streams

Additional Skills

Well-developed analytical, deductive reasoning, and critical thinking skills; comfortable forming assessments from incomplete or ambiguous data
Proven ability to work effectively within a distributed, remote team environment, including willingness to conduct peer review and share tradecraft knowledge
Experience tracking APT, nation-state, or cybercriminal actors, with the ability to contextualize their activity within the broader geopolitical or strategic landscape
Outstanding network infrastructure and traffic analysis skills: PCAP, NetFlow, PDNS, open ports, certificates
Deep working knowledge of IP networking and internet services: DNS, HTTP/HTTPS, TLS, VPNs, and routing protocols (BGP)
Demonstrated knowledge of operating system concepts, including experience developing and contextualizing indicators of compromise and understanding their deployment in host and network-level detection architectures
Working proficiency in SQL and querying and analyzing large disparate datasets
Strong familiarity with common OSINT platforms and research techniques

Highly Desirable Skills

Subject Matter Expert (SME) for a specific regional or threat actor group, with demonstrable depth in their TTPs, infrastructure patterns, and campaign history
Programming or scripting proficiency, preferably Python, for data processing, automation, or tool development
Confident and skilled public speaker with experience presenting technical research to large audiences at industry conferences or similar forums
Familiarity with using AI systems to rapidly prototype analytical tools and develop proof-of-concept projects
Hands-on experience managing remote Linux servers and engineering custom Proof-of-Concept tools to extract, simulate, or generate unique threat data
Working understanding of malware analysis and network analysis: YARA, Zeek, Suricata, Sandbox reporting
Exposure to malware reverse engineering, including static and dynamic analysis techniques and common tooling (e.g. Ghidra, IDA Pro, x64dbg)
Familiarity with the operational structures of hosting providers, ISPs, and internet exchanges, including how infrastructure is provisioned, attributed, and abused by threat actors

Travel

Occasional travel within the UK and internationally for customer workshops, industry events, and team meetings is required

Why Join Team Cymru?

At Team Cymru, we provide unmatched global threat intelligence that empowers organizations to proactively disrupt adversaries. You'll be at the forefront of cybersecurity innovation, helping customers harness the full power of our threat intelligence to achieve critical business and security outcomes.

We offer a collaborative, mission-driven culture where your expertise and impact will directly contribute to improving global security.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply now and help shape the financial future of a company protecting millions worldwide.

This job description is not exhaustive. Responsibilities may evolve as needed. Team Cymru is an equal opportunity employer and welcomes applicants from all backgrounds. This is a remote position.

jobs.title: Technical Program Manager, Enterprise Systems
jobs.description:
Back to jobs

New

Technical Program Manager, Enterprise Systems

Los Angeles, CA

About The Company

General Matter is enriching uranium in America.

Our goal is to design, build, and operate the world’s lowest-cost enrichment services in the United States. 

Our mission is to restore America’s ability to produce nuclear fuel—fuel that will power AI, advanced manufacturing, critical industries, and the next generation of nuclear reactors.

Ultimately, our work will help power national ambitions and enable a high-energy society.

We were incubated by Founders Fund, like Anduril and Palantir before us, and are backed by top-tier investors. Our lean, world-class team of engineers and operators is applying a first-principles approach to solving the problem of nuclear fuel production. 

We are a mission-driven company with a culture of urgency, accountability, and transparency.

Help us build a high-energy society by making the cleanest, safest form of baseload energy the most affordable.

About This Role

As a Technical Program Manager, you will drive the planning, execution, and delivery of our enterprise systems program: the ERP and the manufacturing, quality, supply chain, and finance systems that run the business. You will lead multiple concurrent projects across these platforms, owning schedule, scope, dependencies, risk, budget, governance, and cutover readiness from selection through integration, migration, and phased go-live.

Because these systems serve different stakeholders and company needs, this is a cross-functional leadership role. You will work across every department that depends on these platforms, alongside the Enterprise Systems Architect and external implementation partners, to keep each project on schedule, on budget, and aligned with company priorities. It is ideal for someone who thrives at the intersection of program leadership, enterprise systems, and hands-on execution in a fast-paced, high-impact environment.

Key Stakeholders:
Manufacturing, Engineering, Quality, Supply Chain and Procurement, Finance and Accounting, IT, Security, HR and People, Legal and Compliance, and Executive Leadership.

Responsibilities

Own the integrated program plan and master schedule across concurrent enterprise systems projects, including ERP, MES, QMS, PLM, procurement, CRM, HRIS, and data warehouse, sequencing milestones and the critical path from selection through integration, migration, and phased go-live.
Lead platform selection and vendor evaluation with the Enterprise Systems Architect, running requirements, RFPs, demos, and scoring, and manage external implementation partners and systems integrators against statements of work, milestones, deliverables, and budget.
Manage cross-functional dependencies, scope, and change control across all stakeholder departments, clearing blockers and escalating risks and issues with clear options and recommendations.
Run program governance and executive reporting, including steering-committee cadence, decision logs, action tracking, and regular status on health, risk, and financials.
Drive delivery workstreams to closure across requirements, design, build, testing and user acceptance, integration, and data migration, with defined go/no-go criteria.
Plan and lead cutover, go-live readiness, and hypercare, and lead organizational change management, including stakeholder communications, training, and adoption, through transition to steady-state operations.

Basic Qualifications

8+ years in technical program or project management delivering complex, cross-functional programs.
Led at least one full enterprise systems or ERP implementation from selection through build, migration, and go-live.
Experience managing external implementation partners or systems integrators against scope, schedule, and budget.
Strong command of program management disciplines, including scheduling, dependency management, risk management, budget tracking, and change control.
Technical fluency across enterprise platforms such as ERP, MES, QMS, PLM, procurement, HRIS, and CRM, including integrations, data migration, and cutover, sufficient to lead delivery conversations with architects and integrators.
Experience running program governance and reporting to executive stakeholders, and leading change management and user adoption for enterprise system rollouts.
Strong understanding of manufacturing, supply chain, and quality processes, with excellent stakeholder management and the ability to align partners without direct authority.
Bachelor’s degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Engineering, Business, or a related field, or equivalent experience.

Preferred Skills And Experience

Program or project management certification such as PMP, PgMP, PMI-ACP, or SAFe.
ERP delivery on platforms such as NetSuite, SAP, Oracle, or Microsoft Dynamics, and adjacent platforms such as Salesforce, Workday, ServiceNow, Coupa, Arena, or Teamcenter.
Familiarity with integration and data-migration delivery across enterprise systems such as ERP, MES, QMS, PLM, WMS, CRM, and HRIS, and with delivery tooling such as Jira, Smartsheet, Microsoft Project, Asana, or Confluence.
Experience delivering programs using Agile, Waterfall, and hybrid methodologies, and change frameworks such as Prosci ADKAR or Kotter.
Experience in regulated industries such as aerospace, defense, energy, medical device, automotive, or nuclear, and familiarity with compliance frameworks such as ISO 9001, AS9100, 21 CFR Part 11, SOX, SOC 2, or ISO 27001.

Additional Requirements

Willing to work extended hours and weekends as needed.
Based in Los Angeles, CA, and onsite full-time; hybrid and remote work will not be considered.

Equal Opportunity Employer

General Matter is an Equal Opportunity Employer; employment with General Matter is governed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications and will not be influenced in any manner by race, color, religion, gender, national origin/ethnicity, veteran status, disability status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, mental or physical disability or any other legally protected status.

Compensation And Benefits

The base salary range for this role is $145,000 - $210,000
annually.

Compensation bands are determined by role, level, location, and alignment with market data. Individual level and base pay is determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on job-related skills, education, experience, technical capabilities and internal equity. Please note that the stated salary range is an estimate and may be adjusted based on market conditions, business needs, or other factors. In addition to base salary, for full-time hires, you may also be eligible for long-term incentives, in the form of stock options, and access to medical, vision & dental coverage as well as access to a 401(k) retirement plan.

This is not a remote role. You must be in the area or open to relocation.

Job Summary

The Walt Disney Studios Content Security organization
is chartered with the securing and protection of all creative content throughout the production lifecycle. We do this by relying on deep technical expertise, strong and authentic partnerships and leveraging knowledge and best practices of the world of cybersecurity, technology and production. The Content Security organization is a part of the broader Studio Technology organization, reporting into the Studio’s Chief Technology Officer (CTO).

The Content Security Program Manager reports into the Director of Content Security Engineering and is a Monday to Thursday in the office in-person role based in Glendale, CA. Fridays are remote.

This technical program manager will partner directly with assessment and engineering teams responsible for secure design and integration across cloud platforms, application tools, and AI technologies. You will drive cross-functional programs that enable secure collaboration, ensuring that security principles are embedded throughout the creative and technical pipeline. This role requires strong project and program management skills with technical acumen, and the ability to translate complex requirements into actionable plans.

Key Responsibilities:

Program Leadership: Develop and coordinate a strong program with consideration of the needs of stakeholders and the capabilities and resource availability of the team.
Technical Partnership: Serve as a liaison, guiding partners through the process of having our subject matter experts advise on secure design, architectural reviews, and technical assessments for custom and vendor-supplied tools.
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Build strong relationships within Content Security, across Studio Technology, and business stakeholders to align security initiatives with studio goals and creative workflows.
Process Optimization: Drive continuous improvement, identifying bottlenecks in security workflows, and automating common use cases.
Assessment & Metrics: Develop and maintain dashboards with KPIs to monitor program effectiveness, stakeholder response, and operational metrics. Present program health reports and actionable insights to leadership.
Emerging Technology: Stay ahead of trends in AI, cloud security, and content pipeline tooling
Problem Solving: Lead solutioning for challenges, eliminate roadblocks, and ensure timely delivery of security initiatives.

Basic Qualifications:

Bachelor's degree in related field or equivalent years of experience
Must have 5+ years of experience in technical program management
Must have technical knowledge of cybersecurity and cloud environments (AWS, GCP, Azure)
Proven success leading cross-functional programs and interfacing with engineering teams to implement and optimize security tools.
Excellent communication skills, with experience presenting technical concepts to executive audiences.

Preferred Qualifications:

Entertainment/media industry experience preferred
PMP or equivalent security certifications preferred
Experience with technical tools such as Smartsheet, Tableau, Power BI, and common media production platforms (Adobe, Davinci, Aspera etc..).

jobs.title: Distribution Data Analyst - Bilingual
jobs.description:
About UniUni

UniUni, a North American leader in last-mile logistics, delivers tens of millions of parcels annually in Canada, from Coast to Coast, and is rapidly expanding across the United States. Founded in 2019, UniUni’s tech-driven innovation and crowdsourcing delivery model offers fast, economical, and reliable services to local, national, and international e-commerce clients.

Job Overview

We are looking for a Bilingual Distribution Data Analyst

with strong data analytics capabilities, project execution skills, and excellent cross-functional communication abilities.

In this role, you will support daily operational monitoring, sorting process optimization, and system feature implementation across sorting centers nationwide. You will leverage data analysis to uncover operational bottlenecks and collaborate closely with Warehouse Operations, Product, IT, Quality, and Management teams to drive issue resolution and continuous process improvement.

This position goes beyond pure report building and data monitoring—you will also deeply participate in testing and rolling out sorting systems, warehouse workflows, and new initiatives. It is an ideal role for candidates looking to build a multi-faceted career blending Operations, Data Analytics, and Project Management

.

Key Responsibilities

Sorting Operations Data Monitoring & Analysis
Monitor core operational metrics across all US sorting centers, including sorting volume, automated vs. manual sorting ratios, departure timeliness, exception rates, unloading performance, package status, and process completion rates.
Identify operational anomalies, process bottlenecks, and potential risks through data analysis, and follow up with local hubs to troubleshoot and implement fixes.
Routinely compile operational performance and project data to provide actionable insights for executive leadership.
Dashboard & Reporting Construction
Build and maintain operational Dashboards, daily/weekly reports, and ad-hoc analytical frameworks based on business requirements.
Extract, clean, analyze, and visualize data using Excel, Google Sheets, and other analytical tools.
Continuously refine KPI definitions and data monitoring logic to enhance anomaly detection and operational management efficiency.
Sorting Process & SOP Optimization
Gain a deep, hands-on understanding of warehouse workflows, including sorting, consolidation/bagging, dispatch, unloading, and linehaul transportation.
Identify efficiency gaps based on ground-level operational feedback and drive process optimizations.
Draft, update, and standardize Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) across all hubs.
Track post-optimization performance and validate results using quantitative data.
System Testing & Project Launch Execution
Serve as a primary liaison between Operations and Product/IT teams to collect and synthesize field system requirements.
Participate in feature testing for sorting systems, handheld PDAs, and warehouse operational tools (including test scenario design, on-site testing, bug logging, and post-launch verification).
Facilitate pilots, user training, and nationwide rollouts of new system features and operational workflows across hubs.
Monitor system adoption and operational issues post-launch, coordinating with technical teams for quick resolutions.
Cross-Functional & Multi-Site Collaboration
Maintain daily communication with operational teams across nationwide sorting hubs to track operational exceptions and project execution.
Collaborate with Product, Engineering/IT, Quality, Transportation, and Finance teams to resolve complex cross-departmental issues.
Organize cross-functional meetings, define clear Action Items, and track project milestones.
Act as an effective bridge aligning business needs, system logic, and ground-level warehouse operations.

Qualifications & Requirements

Language Requirement: Bilingual fluency in English and Mandarin Chinese is required (written and spoken) to effectively communicate with bilingual ground ops, technical, and management teams.
Data Proficiency: Strong analytical skills with proficiency in Excel / Google Sheets.
Problem-Solving Skills: Proven ability to pinpoint root causes from complex data and business processes and propose actionable solutions.
Communication & Coordination: Exceptional interpersonal skills to collaborate seamlessly with warehouse staff, product managers, technical engineers, and leadership.
Ownership: Strong self-drive and accountability to manage projects independently and ensure end-to-end execution.
Adaptability: Able to thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic environment while managing multiple tasks and projects simultaneously.

Preferred Qualifications (Nice-to-Haves)

Experience in Logistics, Supply Chain, Warehousing, Last-mile Delivery, or E-commerce Fulfillment.
Direct experience in Distribution Center (DC), Sorting Center, or Warehouse Operations.
Background in software system testing, product requirement gathering, or project launch execution.
Familiarity with Power BI, Tableau, or other BI visualization tools.
Experience collaborating on cross-regional or multi-time-zone projects.

What We Look For in You

This Role Is a Great Fit If You

Are data-driven, but don't want to be confined to just building static spreadsheets;
Enjoy stepping onto the warehouse floor to understand actual ground operations;
Proactively track problems to resolution rather than just reporting them;
Can effectively translate between operational needs, data insights, and technical requirements;
Love driving new initiatives and watching your solutions make a tangible impact on the business.

jobs.title: Project Manager Lean Six Sigma Black Belt
jobs.description:
Job Description

Nous recherchons un Project Manager Lean Six Sigma Black Belt
disposant de 5 à 10 ans d'expérience pour piloter des projets stratégiques d'amélioration continue au sein d'un environnement industriel exigeant. Vous interviendrez sur l'identification, le cadrage et le déploiement d'initiatives visant à optimiser la performance opérationnelle, améliorer la qualité des processus et réduire les coûts de non-qualité à travers l'application des méthodologies Lean Six Sigma.

En collaboration étroite avec les équipes Qualité, Production, Méthodes et les différentes parties prenantes métier, vous conduirez des analyses de données approfondies, animerez des ateliers de résolution de problèmes et assurerez le suivi des plans d'actions jusqu'à l'atteinte des résultats attendus. Vous contribuerez également à la standardisation des processus, à la mise en place d'indicateurs de performance et à l'accompagnement du changement auprès des équipes opérationnelles. Doté(e) d'un fort leadership transverse, d'excellentes capacités d'analyse et d'une certification Lean Six Sigma Black Belt, vous évoluerez dans un contexte industriel à forte exigence qualité nécessitant un niveau d'anglais professionnel.

Vos missions :

Piloter des projets d'amélioration continue Lean Six Sigma (DMAIC / DMADV) en assurant leur cadrage, leur priorisation et leur déploiement en collaboration avec les équipes Qualité et Opérations.
Analyser les données de performance et de qualité afin d'identifier les causes racines, mesurer les écarts et définir les actions correctives appropriées.
Animer des ateliers de résolution de problèmes et d'amélioration continue en utilisant les méthodologies et outils Lean Six Sigma (8D, A3, Ishikawa, 5 Why, Kaizen, etc.).
Optimiser et standardiser les processus qualité en cartographiant les flux, en réduisant les non-conformités, les temps de cycle et les coûts de non-qualité.
Accompagner les équipes dans la conduite du changement, la diffusion des bonnes pratiques et le développement d'une culture d'amélioration continue.
Définir, suivre et communiquer les indicateurs de performance (KPI), assurer le reporting projet et garantir l'atteinte des objectifs de qualité, coûts et délais.

Votre profil
 :

Diplômé(e) d'une formation supérieure Bac+5 (école d'ingénieur ou université) avec une spécialisation en génie industriel, qualité, production, amélioration continue ou domaine connexe.
Vous justifiez de 5 à 10 ans d'expérience en gestion de projets d'amélioration continue au sein d'environnements industriels exigeants tels que l'aéronautique, le spatial, la défense, l'automobile, le ferroviaire ou l'industrie pharmaceutique.
Vous êtes certifié(e) Lean Six Sigma Black Belt et disposez d'une expérience avérée dans la conduite de projets d'optimisation ayant généré des résultats mesurables en termes de qualité, coûts ou délais.
Vous maîtrisez les méthodologies Lean et Six Sigma ainsi que les outils associés (VSM, 5S, Kaizen, Kanban, SMED, SPC, DOE, AMDEC, 8D, analyses statistiques sous Minitab ou équivalent).
Vous possédez une bonne connaissance des systèmes de management de la qualité et des référentiels normatifs ; une expérience dans un environnement certifié EN9100 ou ISO 9001 constitue un atout.
Doté(e) d'un excellent leadership transverse, vous faites preuve de rigueur, d'esprit d'analyse et de pédagogie. Vous êtes capable d'accompagner le changement, d'animer des équipes pluridisciplinaires et d'évoluer dans un contexte international nécessitant un niveau d'anglais professionnel.

Nos avantages
 :

Mutuelle prise en charge à 60% (gratuite pour vos enfants).
Transports pris en charge à 50%.
Possibilité de télétravail avec une rétribution de 2,70 € par jour.
Carte restaurant d'une valeur de 10 € par jour, utilisable jusqu'à 25 €, pris en charge à 60%.
Accès à HelloCSE avec de nombreuses offres et réductions chez Ikea, Pathé, Fnac, Cdiscount, et bien d'autres.
Possibilité de bénéficier d'un bonus de cooptation de 2 000 € !
De nombreuses formations gratuites, incluant des certifications Microsoft.
Compte épargne temps jusqu'à 90 jours.
Participation et intéressement.
Jours de congé supplémentaires pour valoriser votre ancienneté.
3 jours d’absences rémunérées par an pour le parent d’un enfant malade
4 absences autorisés rémunérées pour les conjoint.e.s d’une personne enceinte pour assister aux examens obligatoires prénataux.
Journée de solidarité chômée et payée

Pourquoi nous choisir ?

🚀 Une communauté internationale regroupant plus de 110 nationalités.

💡 Un environnement où la confiance est clé : 70 % de nos leaders ont commencé leur carrière au premier niveau de responsabilités.

📚 Un système de formation solide avec notre Académie interne et plus de 250 modules disponibles.

🎉 Un cadre de travail stimulant, favorisant les rencontres et les échanges (afterworks, team buildings...).

🌍 Un engagement fort en matière de RSE, notamment avec notre programme WeCare Together.

💬 Inclusion et diversité

Amaris Consulting promeut l'égalité des chances. Nous nous engageons à rassembler des talents d’horizons différents et à créer un environnement de travail inclusif. Dans cette optique, nous recueillons les candidatures de toutes les personnes qualifiées, quel que soit leur sexe, orientation sexuelle, race, origine ethnique, croyances, âge, état civil, handicap ou autres caractéristiques .

Who are we?

Amaris Consulting
est une société indépendante de conseil et de technologies au service des entreprises. Avec plus de 1000 clients dans le monde, nous déployons des solutions pour les plus grands projets depuis plus d'une décennie - tout ceci est rendu possible par une équipe internationale de 7 600 talents répartis sur les 5 continents et dans plus de 60 pays. Nos solutions sont axées sur quatre domaines d'activité différents : Les systèmes d'information et le digital, la télécommunication, les sciences de la vie et l'ingénierie. Nous cherchons à créer et à développer une communauté de talents où tous les membres de notre équipe peuvent réaliser leur plein potentiel. Amaris est votre « stepping stone » pour traverser les rivières du changement, pour relever les défis et pour réaliser tous vos projets avec succès.

Chez Amaris, nous avons à cœur d'offrir à nos candidats la meilleure expérience de recrutement possible. Nous cherchons à mieux connaître et comprendre nos candidats, à les challenger et à leur faire part de nos impressions le plus rapidement possible. Voici à quoi ressemble notre processus de recrutement :

Premier contact
: Notre processus commence généralement par une brève conversation virtuelle/téléphonique pour en savoir plus sur vous ! L'objectif ? Apprendre à vous connaître, comprendre vos motivations et veiller à ce que nous vous proposions le poste qui vous correspond le mieux !

Entretiens
(en moyenne, le nombre d'entretiens est de 3 – il peut toutefois varier en fonction du niveau d'ancienneté requis pour le poste). Au cours des entretiens, vous rencontrerez les membres de notre équipe : votre futur manager bien sûr, mais aussi d'autres personnes avec lesquelles vous serez amené à travailler. Ces entretiens nous permettront d'en apprendre davantage sur vous, votre expérience et vos compétences, mais aussi sur le poste et ce que l'on attendra de vous. Bien entendu, vous apprendrez également à connaître Amaris : notre culture, notre histoire, nos équipes et vos opportunités de carrière !

Étude de cas
: En fonction du poste, vous serez peut-être appelé à passer un test. Il pourra s'agir d'un jeu de rôle, d'une évaluation technique, d'un scénario de résolution de problème, etc.

Comme vous le savez, chaque personne est différente et il en va de même pour chaque rôle dans une entreprise. C'est pourquoi nous devons nous adapter en conséquence, si bien que le processus peut parfois être quelque peu différent pour chacun. Cela dit, nous nous mettons toujours à la place du candidat pour lui offrir la meilleure expérience possible. Nous avons hâte de vous rencontrer !

jobs.title: Deployment Strategist
jobs.description:
To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts.

Job Category

Sales

Job Details

About Salesforce

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

We're Salesforce, the Customer Company, inspiring the future of business with AI + Data + CRM. Leading with our core values, we help companies across every industry blaze new trails and connect with customers in a whole new way. And we empower you to be a Trailblazer too, driving your performance and career growth, charting new paths, and improving the state of the world. If you believe in business as the greatest platform for change and in companies doing well and doing good, you've come to the right place.

About The Role

Customer impact from day one. Strategic clarity and Execution that sticks.

Salesforce is hiring Deployment Strategists — Strategic Builders
who are customer-facing advisors, who define AI strategy, shape agentic solutions, and drive measurable adoption for enterprise customers. You'll work as part of a delivery team alongside Forward Deployed Engineers, translating complex business challenges into agentic AI deployments that go live and generate real value. Engagements are focused and time-bound — typically 12 weeks or less — and may span a single strategic account or multiple customers simultaneously. Your impact isn't just getting to deployment. It ensures customers realise lasting, scalable value from the solutions your team builds.

Key Responsibilities

Full Lifecycle Ownership: Lead end-to-end customer engagement across the complete value lifecycle — Identify → Commit → Deploy → Consume — owning outcomes at every stage, not just discovery or deal closure
AI Strategy & Architecture: Define the customer's Agentic AI strategy and roadmap. Lead design workshops, agent design sessions, and jobs-to-be-done analysis. Architect solutions spanning Salesforce's agentic AI platform, Data Cloud, and enterprise systems, with responsible AI governance baked in from the start.
Deployment Oversight & Program Management: Manage engagement delivery end-to-end timelines, stakeholder communication, risk escalation, and progress reporting. You are the operational backbone of your delivery team, ensuring nothing falls through the cracks.
Adoption & Consumption: Own adoption, consumption, and expansion metrics within your engagement scope. Identify blockers early and develop strategies to drive measurable value realization
Delivery Team Coordination: Partner closely with the Forward Deployed Engineers on your team to align strategy with technical execution. Keep the team focused, unblocked, and on track to hit delivery milestones.
AI-Supported Development: You'll be developing real customer solutions supported by leading-edge AI tools: Including
Cursor, Claude, and our coding products like Vibes, to accelerate development.
Customer Stakeholder Management: Serve as the primary customer-facing contact, building trust-based relationships with senior stakeholders and present proposals, decisions and outcomes in terms of business value, not just technical detail.
AI Readiness: Assess customer readiness for AI adoption and guide change management and process transformation to maximise the benefits of intelligent agents
Product Feedback Loop: Synthesise field insights and translate them into actionable product feedback that influences Salesforce's Agentic AI platform roadmap.

Required Qualifications

4+ years experience in strategic solutioning, technical advisory, or delivery leadership or programme management for enterprise cloud or SaaS technology
You have a degree in Computer Science or a related field
Prior customer-facing delivery experience (consulting, professional services, or technical advisory) - this is a requirement, not a nice-to-have
Demonstrated understanding of the Salesforce platform and ecosystem, including Agentic AI capabilities and Data Cloud
Working knowledge of one or more programming languages: Python, JavaScript, Java, or Apex
Proven ability to lead and own complex, ambiguous engagements end-to-end — from discovery through to measurable outcomes
Experience leading AI/LLM solution design, including agentic AI strategy, conversation design, and responsible AI practices
Strong project and programme management skills — ability to run multiple workstreams, manage stakeholder expectations, and keep delivery on track in ambiguous environments
Ability to travel 25% of the time to customer sites

Preferred Experience

Experience with Salesforce Data Cloud, Agentforce platform, and Salesforce CRM (Sales, Service, Marketing)
Experience designing and deploying AI solutions in regulated industries (e.g., public sector, financial services, healthcare)
Salesforce platform certifications (e.g., Data Cloud Consultant, Agentforce Specialist, Application Architect) or similar platform certifications such as Microsoft, Oracle, or similar platforms.
Background in change management, organisational design, or enterprise transformation
Experience with AI/ML concepts beyond LLMs, including NLP, RAG architectures, and model evaluation frameworks
A get-things-done mindset with strong bias for action — comfortable operating in unstructured fast moving environments

Nous sommes Salesforce, la Customer Company, qui inspire l'avenir des entreprises grâce à l'IA + les Données + le CRM. Guidés par nos valeurs fondamentales, nous aidons les entreprises de tous secteurs à ouvrir de nouvelles voies et à se connecter à leurs clients d'une manière entièrement nouvelle. Et nous vous donnons les moyens d'être vous aussi un Trailblazer, en stimulant votre performance et votre évolution de carrière, en traçant de nouveaux chemins et en contribuant à améliorer le monde. Si vous croyez que l'entreprise est la meilleure plateforme pour le changement et que performance économique et impact positif peuvent aller de pair, vous êtes au bon endroit.

À propos du poste

Un impact client dès le premier jour. Une vision stratégique claire et une exécution qui dure.

Salesforce recrute des Deployment Strategists — des Strategic Builders
qui sont des conseillers en contact direct avec les clients, définissent la stratégie IA, façonnent des solutions agentiques et pilotent une adoption mesurable pour les entreprises clientes. Vous travaillerez au sein d'une équipe de delivery aux côtés de Forward Deployed Engineers, en traduisant des défis métier complexes en déploiements d'IA agentique qui passent en production et génèrent une valeur réelle. Les missions sont ciblées et limitées dans le temps — généralement 12 semaines ou moins — et peuvent porter sur un compte stratégique unique ou sur plusieurs clients simultanément. Votre impact ne s'arrête pas au déploiement : vous vous assurez que les clients tirent une valeur durable et scalable des solutions construites par votre équipe.

Responsabilités principales

Ownership complet du cycle de vie : Pilotez l'engagement client de bout en bout sur l'ensemble du cycle de valeur — Identifier → Engager → Déployer → Consommer — en assumant les résultats à chaque étape, pas seulement lors de la découverte ou de la conclusion du deal.
Stratégie & Architecture IA : Définissez la stratégie et la feuille de route IA Agentique du client. Animez des ateliers de conception, des sessions de design d'agents et des analyses jobs-to-be-done. Concevez des solutions couvrant la plateforme d'IA agentique de Salesforce, Data Cloud et les systèmes d'entreprise, avec une gouvernance IA responsable intégrée dès le départ.
Pilotage du déploiement & gestion de programme : Gérez les délais de delivery de bout en bout, la communication avec les parties prenantes, l'escalade des risques et le reporting d'avancement. Vous êtes le pilier opérationnel de votre équipe de delivery, en vous assurant qu'aucun sujet ne passe entre les mailles.
Adoption & Consommation : Soyez responsable des métriques d'adoption, de consommation et d'expansion dans le périmètre de votre mission. Identifiez les blocages en amont et développez des stratégies pour générer une valeur mesurable.
Coordination de l'équipe de delivery : Collaborez étroitement avec les Forward Deployed Engineers de votre équipe pour aligner stratégie et exécution technique. Maintenez l'équipe focalisée, débloquée et sur la bonne trajectoire pour atteindre les jalons de delivery.
Développement assisté par l'IA : Vous développerez de véritables solutions client avec le support d'outils IA de pointe, notamment Cursor, Claude et nos produits de coding comme Vibes, pour accélérer le développement.
Gestion des parties prenantes client : Soyez le principal interlocuteur côté client, en établissant des relations de confiance avec les décideurs seniors et en présentant propositions, décisions et résultats en termes de valeur métier, et non de détail technique.
Maturité IA : Évaluez la capacité du client à adopter l'IA et accompagnez la conduite du changement et la transformation des processus pour maximiser les bénéfices des agents intelligents.
Boucle de feedback produit : Synthétisez les insights terrain et traduisez-les en retours actionnables qui influencent la roadmap de la plateforme d'IA Agentique de Salesforce.

Compétences requises

4 ans d'expérience minimum en solutioning stratégique, conseil technique ou pilotage de delivery / gestion de programme pour des technologies cloud ou SaaS enterprise
Diplôme en Informatique ou dans un domaine connexe
Expérience préalable en delivery en contact client (conseil, services professionnels ou conseil technique) — critère obligatoire, pas un plus
Bonne maîtrise de la plateforme Salesforce et de son écosystème, y compris les capacités d'IA Agentique et Data Cloud
Connaissance opérationnelle d'un ou plusieurs langages de programmation : Python, JavaScript, Java ou Apex
Capacité avérée à piloter et à prendre en charge des missions complexes et ambiguës de bout en bout — de la découverte jusqu'aux résultats mesurables
Expérience dans la conception de solutions IA/LLM, incluant la stratégie d'IA agentique, la conception conversationnelle et les pratiques d'IA responsable
Solides compétences en gestion de projet et de programme — capacité à gérer plusieurs workstreams, à cadrer les attentes des parties prenantes et à maintenir le delivery sur les rails dans des environnements ambigus
Disponibilité pour des déplacements chez les clients à hauteur de 25% du temps

Expériences appréciées

Expérience avec Salesforce Data Cloud, la plateforme Agentforce et le CRM Salesforce (Sales, Service, Marketing)
Expérience dans la conception et le déploiement de solutions IA dans des secteurs réglementés (ex. : secteur public, services financiers, santé)
Certifications Salesforce (ex. : Data Cloud Consultant, Agentforce Specialist, Application Architect) ou certifications équivalentes sur d'autres plateformes (Microsoft, Oracle, etc.)

jobs.description:
Vestiaire Collective is the leading global platform for desirable pre-loved fashion and a pioneer in transforming how people consume fashion.

Our mission is simple: make circular fashion the norm, not the exception.

Through technology, expertise, and a highly engaged global community, we enable millions of people to buy and sell fashion in a more sustainable way.

Founded in Paris in 2009, Vestiaire Collective is now a globally scaled marketplace with offices in Paris, London, Berlin, New York, Singapore, and Ho Chi Minh City, and logistics hubs across Europe, Asia, and the US.

Today, we are a team of around 600 people from over 50 nationalities, united by a shared ambition: to drive meaningful change in the fashion industry.

Our values, Activism, Transparency, Dedication, Greatness, and Collective, shape how we build, collaborate, and grow every day.

Please upload your CVs in English

About the role :

As a Senior Security Analyst at Vestiaire Collective, you will be part of our Security team. Your objective will be to provide a safe, secure, and trustworthy experience for our users, while safeguarding their privacy and personal data, as well as protecting our company assets and internal employees. Additionally, you will ensure compliance with regulatory requirements.

This role is focused on security operations, risk, and assurance: you will be the person who keeps continuous watch over our security posture — monitoring and investigating alerts, driving vulnerabilities through to remediation, supporting incident response, and producing the evidence and metrics that demonstrate our security and compliance to auditors, regulators, and leadership. Reporting to the Head of Security, you will work alongside a talented team of security engineers and collaborate closely with engineering teams and other stakeholders such as legal, finance, and corporate IT.

You will work daily with our security stack: Datadog (SIEM), SentinelOne (EDR), Upwind (CSPM), Cloudflare (WAF and Cloudflare One), and Grafana/Prometheus, on top of our AWS and GCP cloud environments.

What you will do :

Operate and continuously improve our security monitoring: triage and investigate alerts across our detection stack (Datadog SIEM, SentinelOne EDR, Cloudflare), tune detections to reduce noise, and escalate confirmed threats.
Review and prioritize cloud security posture findings (Upwind CSPM) across our AWS and GCP environments, and drive misconfigurations through to resolution with the relevant teams.
Own the vulnerability management lifecycle: consolidate findings from penetration tests, application security reviews, and our bug bounty program; validate and prioritize them; and drive remediation with engineering teams against defined SLAs.
Triage incoming bug bounty submissions: reproduce and assess reported issues, determine severity, and coordinate fixes with the relevant code owners.
Support incident response from detection to closure: first-line investigation, coordination during incidents, documentation, and post-incident follow-up actions.
Support audit and assurance activities: prepare and maintain evidence for external audits, run periodic access reviews (joiners/movers/leavers, privileged access), and keep compliance documentation up to date.
Contribute to security metrics and reporting: maintain and enrich the KPIs and dashboards (Grafana) we use to report our security posture to leadership.
Assess third-party vendors and tools from a security and data-protection standpoint.
Handle day-to-day security requests from across the company (reported phishing, the security inbox, employee questions) and deliver security awareness initiatives to promote a security-conscious culture.

Who you are :

Proven experience (3+ years) in a security analyst, SOC, or security operations role, preferably in a fast-paced startup/scaleup environment.
Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, rigorous documentation habits, and the ability to communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Hands-on experience with SIEM and log analysis platforms (e.g., Datadog, Splunk, Elastic) for alert triage, threat detection, and investigation; familiarity with EDR tooling (e.g., SentinelOne, CrowdStrike) is a strong plus.
Working familiarity with cloud environments (AWS and/or GCP) and cloud security fundamentals - enough to understand, prioritize, and follow up on CSPM and WAF findings.
Solid understanding of vulnerability management and common application threats (e.g., OWASP Top 10) - enough to validate findings, assess real-world impact, and discuss remediation credibly with engineers.
Understanding of compliance frameworks and regulations (e.g., ISO 27001, PCI DSS, SOC 2, GDPR, DSA), with the ability to translate requirements into practical controls, procedures, and audit evidence.
Scripting or query skills (e.g., Python, SQL), for automating routine analysis and digging into data during investigations.
Ability to adapt to a rapidly changing environment and manage multiple priorities.
NICE TO HAVE: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Security, or a related field. Relevant certifications (e.g., CompTIA Security+/CySA+, GIAC GCIH/GCIA, CISA, ISO 27001 Lead Auditor/Implementer) are a plus.

jobs.description:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About The Team

Corporate Security helps keep Stripe secure and Stripes safe by building practical, risk-based programs that enable the company to operate and grow. We are looking for an experienced Regional Security Manager to join our team. As the Regional Security Manager Americas at Stripe, you will be responsible for developing our core physical-security deliverables to office locations in the Americas (North America and parts of Latin America), and help evolve our program to support Stripe around the globe. You will work cross functionally within the Corporate Security team, and alongside other business teams at the company to keep Stripe secure and Stripes safe.

What you’ll do

As Regional Security Manager Americas, reporting to the Head of Global Security Operations, you will lead and continuously improve physical security operations across North America and relevant parts of Latin America. This is an individual-contributor role: you will manage regional contractors and vendor relationships, but will not directly manage employees at this time. You will translate regional risk into scalable programs, build trusted partnerships with internal teams and service providers, and help evolve Stripe’s global security operating model.

This is a hybrid role. The successful candidate will spend 50% of their time in one of our AMER office locations in San Francisco, New York, Seattle, or Chicago. We are not entertaining remote candidates at this time.

Responsibilities

Own regional physical-security operations for the Americas, including security governance, escalations, incident response, service delivery, and performance reporting; contribute to global programs as needed.
Partner with teams such as Workplace, People, IT, Events, business leaders, and external providers to deliver a security program that scales with business needs while preserving a high-quality employee and visitor experience.
Lead or coordinate risk, threat, vulnerability, and site-security assessments; document material risks; prioritize mitigations; and track delivery to closure. Conduct annual site-security assessments and risk reviews for company sites and relevant vendor sites to evaluate and improve controls in line with regional risk and established standards.
Develop, maintain, and test clear policies, standard operating procedures, and playbooks covering office security, escalation, incident documentation, event support, and crisis response.
Manage regional security contractors, service providers, and guard-force partners through defined scopes, service-level expectations, key performance indicators, quarterly business reviews, and corrective-action plans.
Partner with Business Continuity, Crisis Management, and Environmental Health & Safety to ensure regional emergency and crisis-response plans are current, practicable, and exercised regularly.
Partner with the Security Systems team as a regional decision maker to define and support physical-security technology design for new offices, relocations, expansions, and significant workplace changes. Ensure appropriate CCTV, alarm, and access-control capabilities are in place, functional, and aligned to regional risk and escalation needs across the region’s offices.
Own regional operational planning and budgeting: forecast spend, identify cost and service improvements, and manage approved programs responsibly.
Design and deliver security-awareness and education initiatives that help employees make safer decisions and strengthen Stripe’s security culture.
Lead cross-functional security projects that reduce risk, improve resilience, and produce measurable operational outcomes.

Who you are

You are an experienced physical-security leader who pairs sound judgment with a practical, service-oriented approach. You can move comfortably between strategic program design and hands-on operational problem solving. You communicate clearly with executives, frontline partners, and vendors; make progress amid ambiguity; and build durable relationships across diverse geographic and business contexts.

Minimum Requirements

8+ years of progressively responsible physical-security, corporate-security, or closely related risk-management experience supporting a multinational organization, including responsibility for operations in the Americas.
Demonstrated experience designing, operating, and measuring risk-based physical-security programs across multiple sites or jurisdictions.
Experience conducting risk, threat, vulnerability, or site-security assessments and translating findings into prioritized, practical mitigations.
Experience managing security vendors or guard-force/service-provider relationships through scopes of work, performance measures, service reviews, and issue resolution.
Experience leading or materially contributing to incident, emergency, or crisis-response planning and exercises.
Strong program and project-management skills, with the ability to prioritize multiple concurrent initiatives and communicate tradeoffs, risks, and progress.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills and the ability to influence cross-functional stakeholders without relying on direct authority.
Sound judgment, discretion, and a demonstrated commitment to employee safety, privacy, and an inclusive workplace experience.
Ability to travel within the Americas and internationally up to 25%, including occasionally on short notice.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience in a technology, financial-services, or other fast-growing, globally distributed organization.
Experience supporting office construction, relocations, expansions, or physical-security system design.
Experience with access-control, video-surveillance, alarm, or other enterprise physical-security technologies and the governance that accompanies them.
Experience managing security operations at large scale public events.
Relevant degree, CPP/PSP, or comparable professional certification; equivalent practical experience is also valued.
Established professional relationships across the security industry, public-sector partners, or relevant regional networks.
Professional fluency in Spanish

Hybrid work at Stripe

This role is available either in an office or a remote location (35+ miles or 56+ km from a Stripe office).

In-office expectations

Office-assigned Stripes spend at least 50% of the time in a given month in their local office or with users. This hits a balance between bringing people together for in-person collaboration and learning from each other, while supporting flexibility about how to do this in a way that makes sense for individuals and their teams.

Working remotely at Stripe

A remote location is defined as being 35 miles (56 kilometers) or more from one of our offices. While you would be welcome to come into the office for team/business meetings, on-sites, meet-ups, and events, our expectation is you would regularly work from home rather than a Stripe office. Stripe does not cover the cost of relocating to a remote location. We encourage you to apply for roles that match the location where you currently live or plan to live.

Pay and benefits

The annual US base salary range for this role is $172,600 - $258,800. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. This salary range may be inclusive of several career levels at Stripe and will be narrowed during the interview process based on a number of factors, including the candidate’s experience, qualifications, and location. Applicants interested in this role and who are not located in the US may request the annual salary range for their location during the interview process.

Additional benefits for this role may include: equity, company bonus or sales commissions/bonuses; 401(k) plan; medical, dental, and vision benefits; and wellness stipends.

We look forward to hearing from you.

At Stripe, we're looking for people with passion, grit, and integrity. You're encouraged to apply even if your experience doesn't precisely match the job description. Your skills and passion will stand out—and set you apart—especially if your career has taken some extraordinary twists and turns. At Stripe, we welcome diverse perspectives and people who think rigorously and aren't afraid to challenge assumptions. Join us.
